name: Niagara Falls
tagline: Six thousand cubic metres of water pouring over the edge every second, best experienced from a boat close enough to feel the spray.
highlight: Standing at the rail as the boat pushes right into Horseshoe Falls' mist, the roar suddenly drowning out every other sound.
shortDescription: One of the world's most powerful waterfalls, straddling the US-Canada border, with Niagara-on-the-Lake's wine country just up the parkway.
metaDescription: A Niagara Falls travel guide: Horseshoe Falls, the Maid of the Mist boat tour, Niagara-on-the-Lake, wine country, food and how to plan a visit.
nearestAirport: Toronto Pearson International Airport (YYZ), about 1.5 hours by road
knownFor: Horseshoe Falls, the Maid of the Mist boat tour, Niagara-on-the-Lake wine country
goodFor: Iconic sightseeing, wine tasting, an easy Toronto day trip
intro: Niagara Falls is genuinely one of the most powerful waterfalls on Earth, over six thousand cubic metres of water pouring over the edge every second where the Niagara River meets the US-Canada border.
The Canadian side genuinely offers the better view, looking directly across at the curved Horseshoe Falls rather than standing on top of it as visitors on the American side do.
Just up the Niagara Parkway, the genuinely charming town of Niagara-on-the-Lake anchors one of Canada's best wine regions, known especially for its distinctive ice wine.

whyVisit.intro: Niagara Falls' case rests genuinely on raw natural power paired with an easy, well-set-up visitor experience.

points.title: The falls are genuinely as powerful as their reputation suggests
points.text: Six thousand cubic metres of water a second, a sight that photographs undersell.

points.text: A direct look at Horseshoe Falls, rather than standing on top of it.

points.title: The boat tours are genuinely a real thrill
points.text: Getting close enough to feel the falls' spray and hear their full roar.

points.title: Niagara-on-the-Lake is genuinely a worthwhile pairing

attractionsIntro: Niagara Falls' essential sights are genuinely centred on the falls themselves, with wine country a short drive away.

attractions.name: Horseshoe Falls
attractions.text: Genuinely the larger and more powerful of Niagara's two main falls, its curved shape giving the site its name.
attractions.tip: Genuinely the view from Table Rock, right at the edge, is the closest you can get without a boat.

attractions.name: Niagara Falls illuminated at night
attractions.text: Genuinely a spectacular nightly show, coloured floodlights transforming the falls after dark.
attractions.tip: Genuinely check for a fireworks schedule, held on select nights through the summer season.

attractions.name: The Maid of the Mist / Hornblower boat tour

image.file: File:Maid of the Mist, Horseshoe Falls, Niagara Falls, Ontario (29901862121).jpg
image.alt: A boat tour approaching Horseshoe Falls

attractions.text: Genuinely the classic Niagara experience, a boat sailing right into the falls' base mist.
attractions.tip: Genuinely wear the provided poncho — you will get properly wet regardless.

attractions.name: Niagara-on-the-Lake's historic Old Town

image.file: File:Historic Old Town, Niagara-on-the-Lake, ON, Canada - panoramio.jpg
image.alt: The historic Old Town of Niagara-on-the-Lake

attractions.text: Genuinely one of Canada's best-preserved 19th-century towns, its main street lined with heritage buildings and boutiques.
attractions.tip: Genuinely combine with a wine-tasting stop — this is the heart of Niagara's wine country.

attractions.name: Niagara's wine country vineyards
attractions.text: Genuinely one of Canada's premier wine regions, its cool climate especially suited to producing distinctive ice wine.
attractions.tip: Genuinely book a winery tour ahead in peak summer and harvest season.

attractions.name: The view from Skylon Tower

image.file: File:Niagara Falls USA Canada from Skylon Tower on 2002-05-28.png
image.alt: The view over Niagara Falls from Skylon Tower

attractions.text: Genuinely a sweeping overview, taking in both Horseshoe and American Falls from a single elevated vantage point.
attractions.tip: Genuinely go near sunset to see the falls in daylight and illuminated within the same visit.

attractions.name: Rainbows over Horseshoe Falls
attractions.text: Genuinely a common, delightful sight, mist and sunlight combining into rainbows over the falls on clear days.
attractions.tip: Genuinely most likely in the morning, when the sun angle lines up best with the mist.

thingsToDoIntro: Niagara Falls genuinely rewards both classic tourist experiences and a slower afternoon in nearby wine country.

thingsToDo.title: Ride the boat right up to the falls

image.file: File:Hornblower Niagara Cruise Passing Maid of the Mist, Horseshoe Falls, Niagara Falls, Ontario (29871584182).jpg
image.alt: A boat tour at Horseshoe Falls

thingsToDo.text: A genuinely essential Niagara experience, sailing close enough to feel the falls' full force and spray.
thingsToDo.tip: Genuinely book online ahead in peak summer to skip the ticket queue.

thingsToDo.title: See the falls illuminated and watch for fireworks
thingsToDo.text: A genuinely lovely evening activity, the falls glowing under coloured lights after dark.
thingsToDo.tip: Genuinely check the current fireworks schedule — not every night includes a show.

thingsToDo.title: Drive or cycle the Niagara Parkway
thingsToDo.text: A genuinely scenic route, following the river from the falls up toward Niagara-on-the-Lake through orchards and vineyards.
thingsToDo.tip: Genuinely a good half-day activity if you have a car or rent a bike for part of the route.

thingsToDo.title: Taste wine in Niagara-on-the-Lake

image.file: File:Wine grapes nearing harvest in Ontario-also example of trellis wire.jpg
image.alt: Vineyards nearing harvest in Niagara wine country

thingsToDo.text: A genuinely worthwhile change of pace from the falls themselves, sampling the region's distinctive ice wine and other varietals.
thingsToDo.tip: Genuinely several wineries offer tastings without a booking, though tours are best arranged ahead.

thingsToDo.title: Explore Niagara-on-the-Lake's Queen Street shops

image.file: File:'Versions'- a Canadian gifts store and a premium clothing store in Niagara on the Lake (27617473330).jpg
image.alt: Shops on Queen Street in Niagara-on-the-Lake

thingsToDo.text: A genuinely relaxed way to spend an afternoon, browsing boutiques along one of Canada's prettiest main streets.
thingsToDo.tip: Genuinely stop for afternoon tea at one of the town's historic inns.

thingsToDo.title: Get soaked behind the falls
thingsToDo.text: A genuinely thrilling experience, tunnels leading to viewing points directly behind the curtain of Horseshoe Falls.
thingsToDo.tip: Genuinely wear the provided poncho, and expect to get wet regardless.

bestTime.headline: June to September for warm weather and full boat tour access
bestTime.summary: Niagara Falls is genuinely a year-round destination, with each season offering a different character.

seasons.text: Genuinely the busiest, warmest season, with the boat tours and fireworks both running in full.
Genuinely pleasant weather with wine harvest season underway and noticeably fewer crowds.
Genuinely striking with ice formations around the falls, though boat tours typically pause for the season.
Genuinely a pleasant shoulder season, with boat tours resuming as the weather warms.

bestTime.avoid: Genuinely nothing strongly, though winter closes the boat tours and some outdoor attractions.

tipsIntro: Practical notes that make a Niagara Falls visit noticeably smoother.
tips: Book genuinely boat tour tickets online ahead in peak summer.
Bring genuinely a change of clothes — you will get wet on the boat tour or behind the falls.
Visit genuinely Table Rock early morning for the clearest view before crowds build.
Combine genuinely a wine-tasting stop with Niagara-on-the-Lake for a fuller day trip.
Check genuinely the fireworks schedule if a night visit is part of your plan.
Consider genuinely staying overnight rather than a rushed day trip to see the falls illuminated.

faq.q: Is the Canadian side of Niagara Falls better than the American side?
faq.a: Yes, genuinely — the Canadian side offers a direct view of Horseshoe Falls, widely considered the better vantage point.

faq.q: How many days do you need at Niagara Falls?
faq.a: One day genuinely covers the falls themselves; two allows time for Niagara-on-the-Lake's wine country too.

faq.q: How do you get from Toronto to Niagara Falls?
faq.a: Genuinely easiest by train, bus or car, all taking around 1.5 to 2 hours.

faq.q: Is the boat tour worth it?
faq.a: Yes, genuinely — it's the closest you can get to the falls, and the spray and roar are genuinely unforgettable up close.

faq.q: Can you visit Niagara Falls in winter?
faq.a: Yes, genuinely — the ice formations are striking, though the boat tours typically pause for the season.
Yes, genuinely — it's one of Canada's prettiest towns, and the surrounding wine country produces genuinely excellent ice wine.
